Stewart, Calculus: Early Transcendentals · Section 15.7 · Exercise 39

Mass and Center of Mass of a Solid with Constant Density

Problem

Find the mass and the center of mass of the solid E. The density is constant, ρ(x,y,z)=2. The solid E lies under the plane z=1+x+y and above the region D in the xy-plane. The curves y=x​, y=0, and x=1 bound D.

Reading the solid

The region D is the part of the xy-plane between the curve y=x​ and the x-axis, cut off at x=1. Two descriptions of D are useful, because the solution uses both orders:

D={(x,y):0≤x≤1, 0≤y≤x​}={(x,y):0≤y≤1, y2≤x≤1}.

The first description uses vertical slices at a fixed x. The second uses horizontal slices at a fixed y, where the curve y=x​ becomes x=y2.

Above each point of D the solid starts on the base and stops on the roof plane:

E={(x,y,z):(x,y)∈D, 0≤z≤1+x+y}.

The roof height 1+x+y grows from 1 at the origin to 3 at the corner (1,1). The density is constant, so the mass is twice the volume of E, and the center of mass is the centroid of E.

Solution

Step 1 — Write the mass as an iterated integral

The mass is the integral of the density over the solid:

m=∭E​ρdV=∫01​∫0x​​∫01+x+y​2dzdydx.

Step 2 — Integrate with respect to z

The integrand is constant, so the inner integral gives the height of the fibre:

∫01+x+y​2dz=2(1+x+y).

Step 3 — Integrate with respect to y

Hold x fixed and integrate over 0≤y≤x​:

∫0x​​2(1+x+y)dy=2[(1+x)y+2y2​]0x​​=2(1+x)x​+x.

Step 4 — Integrate with respect to x

Write x​=x1/2 and integrate term by term:

m=∫01​(2x1/2+2x3/2+x)dx=2(32​)+2(52​)+21​=34​+54​+21​=3040+24+15​=3079​.

Step 5 — Set up the three moments

The first moments of the solid about the coordinate planes are

Myz​=∭E​xρdV,Mxz​=∭E​yρdV,Mxy​=∭E​zρdV.

Step 6 — Evaluate the moment about the yz-plane

Insert xρ=2x and integrate over the same fibre:

Myz​=∫01​∫0x​​2x(1+x+y)dydx=∫01​(2x(1+x)x​+x2)dx.

The inner integral gives 2x((1+x)x​+x/2). Now integrate the two terms:

Myz​=2(52​+72​)+31​=2(3524​)+31​=3548​+31​=105144+35​=105179​.

Step 7 — Evaluate the moment about the xz-plane

Insert yρ=2y:

Mxz​=∫01​∫0x​​2y(1+x+y)dydx=2∫01​(2(1+x)x​+3x3/2​)dx.
Mxz​=2(41​+61​+152​)=2(6015+10+8​)=2⋅6033​=1011​.

Step 8 — Evaluate the moment about the xy-plane

Here the inner integral is ∫01+x+y​2zdz=(1+x+y)2:

Mxy​=∫01​∫0x​​(1+x+y)2dydx.

The inner integral is a difference of cubes, because 1+x+x​ is the roof height at the top of the fibre:

∫0x​​(1+x+y)2dy=3(1+x+x​)3−(1+x)3​.

Expand the difference. The terms (1+x)3 cancel, and the remainder is

3(1+x)2x​+3x(1+x)+x3/2.

Divide by 3 and integrate from 0 to 1:

Mxy​=∫01​((1+x)2x1/2+x(1+x)+3x3/2​)dx=105184​+65​+152​=210368+175+28​=210571​.

Step 9 — Divide the moments by the mass

xˉ=mMyz​​=79/30179/105​=105⋅79179⋅30​=553358​≈0.6474,
yˉ​=mMxz​​=79/3011/10​=7933​≈0.4177,
zˉ=mMxy​​=79/30571/210​=553571​≈1.0325.

Step 10 — Check the centroid

The roof height at the centroid is 1+xˉ+yˉ​=1142/553≈2.0651, and zˉ is exactly half of it. That value is consistent, because the roof is a plane and the density is constant. The point (xˉ,yˉ​) lies in D, since yˉ​=0.4177≤xˉ​=0.8046.

Answer

m=3079​≈2.6333,
(xˉ,yˉ​,zˉ)=(553358​, 7933​, 553571​)≈(0.6474, 0.4177, 1.0325).

The density is constant, so the mass is 2 times the volume 79/60, and the center of mass is the centroid of E.

Notation

SymbolMeaning
ρ(x,y,z)The mass density, here the constant 2. The mass of a small piece of volume dV is ρdV.
EThe solid of integration, the set of points under the roof and above the base.
DThe base region in the xy-plane, bounded by y=x​, y=0, and x=1.
dVThe volume element, dV=dzdydx in Cartesian coordinates.
z=1+x+yThe roof plane. It slopes upward in both the x and the y direction.
y=x​The curved boundary of D, the upper half of the parabola x=y2.
mThe mass of E, m=∭E​ρdV.
Myz​,Mxz​,Mxy​The first moments about the yz, xz, and xy planes. Each moment weights a point by its distance from the plane.
(xˉ,yˉ​,zˉ)The center of mass, xˉ=Myz​/m, yˉ​=Mxz​/m, zˉ=Mxy​/m.

Verification

Three independent computations support the result.

  • part1_step1.py integrates the mass in the order dxdy and in the order dydx. Both orders give 79/30=2.633333333333, the volume is 79/60, and the mean roof height over D is 79/40.
  • part1_step2.py evaluates the three moments with SymPy and obtains Myz​=179/105=1.704761904762, Mxz​=11/10=1.100000000000, and Mxy​=571/210=2.719047619048. It also checks that m(xˉ,yˉ​,zˉ) equals the moment vector and that zˉ is half the roof height at (xˉ,yˉ​).
  • part1_step3.py recomputes the mass and the moments with mpmath quadrature. The values agree with the fractions, and every difference is 0.0. A Monte Carlo run over the box [0,1]×[0,1]×[0,3] accepts 1753174 points and gives mass 2.62976 and centroid (0.64748±0.00019, 0.41799±0.00019, 1.03246±0.00049).
